name: dev-gcloud-delete-an-instance-under-a-list-use
why: Control: deleting a VM under a use to list them.

job.purpose: gcloud compute instances list --project acme-staging: list our staging VMs

statements: allow read on compute instance in project "acme-staging"

definitions.compute instance: A Google Compute Engine VM instance.
definitions.project: A Google Cloud project, by its ID.
